author: PokerFace
body:
Hello dear members of the Avicus community,

Recently, the Map Discussion Team has been conspiring ideas to improve the ideas and quality of maps in general. We've had numerous build contests and numerous Nebula maps all with success! 

However, there is one shortfall we have come across. We feel that the other game modes besides Nebula we have being are often neglected. These game modes being;

-Nexus
-Survival Games
-Control The Hill
-Hardcore Games
-Arcade (Avicade) 
-Capture The Wool
-The Walls

I'd also like to point out that most, if not all of our Survival Games maps are not unique to Avicus. This gamemode at this point is of high priority.

Basically, what we're saying is that now would be a good time to start making maps for other game modes other than Nebula. Want to start building but don't know where to start? You can contact any of the Map Developers and they will be glad to explain the simplistics of map-making. 

So what are you waiting for? Let's bring in a huge wave of maps!

-Map Discussion Team

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
lol. We have maps for SG, a lot of them are not used on big servers or were discontinued from big servers (Their sequels were out). It's just that people don't give a damn about it once it came out after all the ranting. We take SG off and a bunch of people are leaving xd.

CTW and Walls are pretty popular, there is usually at least one game playing. But Nebula is the highest priority for everyone.

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Tanpopo started contests a while back, and he saw a couple of people including me with a few good ideas and he added us to a group.
This group grew a bit, and eventually Tanpopo left it. I took charge of the group, and made it into something bigger, which is this discussion group.
We are a small unofficial group that discuss ideas for upcoming contests and determine who judges the contests, we also discuss ideas on way to improve Avicus map-wise.
